$comment: Single source of truth for every module that ships in the conxa-app zip
(the disk-resident app layer). Consumed by BOTH build pipelines so their
file lists can never drift again:
Source layout: app-layer modules live in runtime/app/. bootstrap.js is NOT
listed — it runs only from inside the host exe (pkg-bundled); nothing on
disk ever loads a conxa-app/ copy of it.
Obfuscation profiles (must stay in lockstep between both consumers):
default           — full protection: self-defending + rc4 string-array
in-page           — page_scripts.js holds functions Playwright serializes
into the BROWSER page realm; string-array/self-defending
inject a module-scope decoder var that does not exist
once the source is re-parsed there, breaking those
functions at runtime. Mangled identifiers are safe

files.name: login_signals.js
files._note: browser.js requires this — multi-signal login detection.

files.name: login_decision_log.js
files._note: browser.js requires this — human-override logging for login decisions.

files.name: browser_session.js
files._note: browser.js requires this — the one registry of live Chromium instances (session lease + the 5-instance cap).

files.name: auth_cache.js
files._note: browser.js requires this — on-disk auth-validation TTL cache + remembered landing URL.

files.name: host_browser.js
files._note: browser.js's _buildExecContext and tabs.js's user-opened-tab branch both require this — the seam that borrows a browser view from Conxa Execute's panel instead of launching Chromium.

files.name: errors.js
files._note: server.js/run.js require this — the one place raw internal/Playwright error text is shaped into a plain summary.

files.name: canonical_json.js
files._note: Stable JSON stringify (sorted keys) used by tracker evidence-chain hashing and dual-shipped manifest_manager signing.

files.name: policy_gate.js
files._note: server.js requires this: local policy/hours/origin gates before a run starts.

files.name: env.js
files._note: server/browser/run/auth_manager fall back to this when global.__conxaEnv is absent (standalone dev mode: node server.js).

files.name: host_bridge.js
files._note: Centralized host-globals accessors (__hostRequire etc.) — required by config_edit/sync/manifest_manager/server/run/browser/auth_manager.

files.name: cli_installer.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: CLI installer mode.

files.name: recovery_park.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: parked-recovery state, keyed per skill (RT-3).

files.name: run_registry.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: multi-run execution registry (RT-3) — replaces the old single activeExecution slot.

files.name: update_gate.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: refuses new runs while a newer host exe is staged but this process is still the old one.

files.name: host_lock.js
files._note: Per-external-host mutual exclusion (RT-3 follow-up) — serializes only runs that overlap on the same target platform.

files.name: target_hosts.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: resolveTargetHosts — every required app's host per run, feeding host_lock.js; pure so the multi-app union stays unit-testable.

files.name: page_eval.js
files._note: EXEC-29 Guard A: deadline-wrapped page/locator .evaluate() seam; required by resolution.js, assertions.js, failure_response.js.

files.name: failure_response.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: Tier 3/4 failure-payload assembly.

files.name: artifact_store.js
files._note: Content-addressed store for recovery artifacts; required by sync.js and failure_response.js.

files.name: recovery_stage.js
files._note: Split Tier 3 (semantic) → Tier 4 (vision) escalation stage + stagnation hard cap + candidate_index nomination maps.

files.name: candidate_digest.js
files._note: Pure: browser-use-style ranked indexed candidate digest for Tier 3 semantic recovery (rank-then-cap, selector derivation).

files.name: tool_defs.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: static MCP tool definitions.

files.name: run_config.js
files._note: Extracted from run.js seams: env-tunable constants.

files.name: recovery_log.js
files._note: Extracted from run.js seams: durable recovery log.

files.name: interpolate.js
files._note: Extracted from run.js seams: input interpolation.

files.name: resolution.js
files._note: run.js seam: candidate gathering + scoring orchestration.

files.name: assertions.js
files._note: run.js seam: step assertion verification.

files.name: settle.js
files._note: EXEC-37: run.js failure-path settle-detection fallback before recovery.

files.name: env_match.js
files._note: EXEC-36: pure recorded-vs-live environment comparison used by run.js's pre-execution warning gate.

files.name: locators.js
files._note: run.js seam: locator strategy construction.

files.name: handlers.js
files._note: run.js seam: per-action-type step handlers.

files.name: date_picker.js
files._note: Pure date-picker replay math (handlers.js's date_pick adapter uses it) — parse/format/header/selector helpers, no Playwright.

files.name: choice.js
files._note: Pure multiple-choice replay math (handlers.js's set_radio/select/select_option/set_checkbox adapters use it), same split as date_picker.js.

files.name: cascade.js
files._note: run.js seam: recovery cascade orchestration.

files.name: overlay_capture.js
files._note: cascade.js requires this: BUILD-26 overlay capture for copilot verify.

files.name: dismiss_patterns.js
files._note: Pure: known consent/cookie-toolkit accept/close selectors for the dismiss-overlay Tier 1 remedy.

files.name: learned_dismissals.js
files._note: Per-host learned dismiss-overlay winners store (CONXA_DATA_DIR/learned_overlays.json, TTL + caps).

files.name: uploads.js
files._note: run.js seam: file-upload handling.

files.name: retry_budget.js
files._note: run.js seam: per-skill retry budget.

files.name: step_utils.js
files._note: Shared step-shape helpers (asObject/asArray/unique).

files.name: marker_span.js
files._note: Marker-block span helpers shared by config_edit paths; dual-shipped with host/config_edit_toml.js which reaches it through __hostRequire.

files.name: durable_context.js
files._note: sync.js -> durable_context.js -> config_edit.js/mcp_hosts.js — all must ship here, not just be bundled into the host exe, since sync.js loads them from disk at runtime. Missing here means every sync silently fails to update discoverability files.

files.name: sync_errors.js
files._note: server.js requires this directly (not caught by any try/catch) — omitting it hard-crashes on load with "Cannot find module './sync_errors'".

files.name: cron_lite.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: minimal cron-expression parser/next-fire calculator for local schedules (PROD-5).

files.name: file_lock.js
files._note: Heartbeat-stamped lock files — makes host_lock.js mutual exclusion hold across engine processes (chat-host vs scheduler-daemon).

files.name: review_pause.js
files._note: Extracted from server.js: review-pause gate for scheduled runs (PROD-5).

files.name: handover.js
files._note: EXEC-21: hand-over pause/resume primitive (banner/file/loopback-HTTP signals) — run.js and server.js both require it directly; omitting it hard-crashes any pack containing a handover step.

files.name: scheduler_cli.js
files._note: Schedule subcommand handlers shared by host/cli_schedule.js dispatch (PROD-5).

files.name: scheduler_daemon.js
files._note: Standalone daemon firing scheduled skills with no chat app open (PROD-5); uses file_lock.js for cross-process exclusion.

files.name: scheduler_store.js
files._note: Encrypted local schedule store backing create/list/delete_schedule MCP tools (PROD-5).
